subject.title: Group reply pipeline silently drops agent-generated payload between turn completion and Telegram sendMessage

question: For substantive generated Telegram replies that miss the message tool under message_tool_only, should OpenClaw recover delivery or keep the current private-by-policy behavior with diagnostics only?
rationale: Current main documents message_tool_only suppression as intentional, while this issue and the linked recovery PR show that substantive generated replies can look like message loss; automation cannot choose that privacy/product contract.

options.title: Review recovery PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88992 as the candidate implementation for a bounded retry/recovery path, then close this issue after merge or rejection.

options.title: Keep warning-only policy
options.body: Decide that message_tool_only final text remains private by contract and close this issue with docs/config guidance once that direction is explicit.

options.title: Request live Telegram repro first
options.body: Pause the product choice until a current-main live Telegram group/topic run separates reaction failure from message_tool_only suppression and bot identity behavior.

recommendation.title: Review recovery PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88992 as the candidate implementation for a bounded retry/recovery path, then close this issue after merge or rejection.

likelyOwner.reason: Their open PR is the active implementation candidate for the remaining stranded-reply behavior.
